title: FIFA World Cup 2026 final groups snapshot

title: Johan Cruyff biographical snapshot
text: Johan Cruyff was a Dutch forward and attacking midfielder associated with Ajax, Barcelona and Feyenoord, and his playing and coaching ideas are strongly associated with Total Football.

title: Michel Platini biographical snapshot
text: Michel Platini was a French attacking midfielder associated with Nancy, Saint-Etienne and Juventus, and won the Ballon d'Or three times in a row from 1983 to 1985.
